title.zh: Binance ends Funding Account crypto deposits as Pay and Convert move to Spot
title.en: Binance ends Funding Account crypto deposits as Pay and Convert move to Spot

current_state.zh: Binance has ended direct on-chain crypto deposits into Funding Accounts and moved Binance Pay receipts and Convert settlements to Spot, with existing balances migrated and Pay spending from Funding phased out on a later schedule.
